source_caption:
Imagine creating a disaster and then acting like you’re the only one who can save the world 😭💀

Tom Cruise stars in DIGGER as the most powerful man on Earth, trying to convince everyone that he’s humanity’s savior while desperately attempting to stop the catastrophe he caused from destroying everything.

That’s a pretty crazy concept for a movie. Having all the money, power, and influence in the world is one thing, but talking your way out of a disaster you created yourself is a whole different story 😂

Directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu, the filmmaker behind Birdman and The Revenant, DIGGER brings Cruise together with a talented cast featuring Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Jesse Plemons.

The premise alone makes you wonder just how chaotic things will get. When the person responsible for the problem also believes he’s the one who can fix it, you already know everything is about to spiral out of control 🍿

source_details.title: Digger
source_details.synopsis: Digger is a 2026 American satirical black comedy film co-written, directed, and co-produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu. Tom Cruise, who also produced the film, stars in the role of Digger Rockwell, an aging oil magnate whose drilling sets off an ecological disaster. The supporting cast includes Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Jesse Plemons. Iñárritu conceived the idea for Digger after working on The Revenant (2015). He wrote the screenplay with Sabina Berman, Alexander Dinelaris Jr., and Nicolás Giacobone, from a story by Iñárritu, Berman, and Jez Butterworth. Filming took place from November 2024 to May 2025 in the United Kingdom. Digger premiered in Leice
